title: T-20260703-support-brand-new-project-intake-workflo - Support Brand-New Project Intake Workflow From Source Documents

included: CLI workflow design and implementation for project-intake MVP.
Artifact schema or file layout for project-intake evidence.
Readiness gates that distinguish raw, analyzed, confirmed, planned, and decomposed states.
Tests covering project-intake and backlog compatibility.
excluded: Replacing current backlog, quick, or standard task flows.
Auto-promoting generated backlog items without user confirmation.

major_change_gate.user_confirmed: User explicitly requested: “继续推进，同意promote 成active task 然后进入spec/plan”.
major_change_gate.decision_brief_markdown:
- 当前问题: DocPath lacks a strong path for brand-new projects that start from raw source documents instead of scoped backlog items.
- 目标: Create an upstream project-intake workflow that turns raw project materials into confirmed project artifacts and then backlog items.
- 背景: R-242 was captured, analyzed, confirmed, and explicitly approved for promotion by the user on 2026-07-03.
- 可选方案:
  - 方案 A: Keep using backlog for everything.
  - 方案 B: Extend backlog with a project profile.
  - 方案 C: Add a distinct project-intake workflow that can later generate backlog items.
- 推荐方案: 方案 C.
- 决策理由: Brand-new project discovery has different semantics from incremental backlog work. A separate workflow keeps granularity clear, avoids breaking existing backlog behavior, and gives agents a safer route for analysis before implementation.
- 不做什么: Do not implement binary PPT/PDF parsing, product UI, external LLM calls, or automatic promotion.
- 成本: Medium to high; this touches workflow state, routing, artifact conventions, CLI commands, and tests.
- 风险: Misclassification as quick, artifact sprawl, compatibility regressions in backlog flows, and unclear conversion gates.
- 回滚方案: Keep existing backlog behavior untouched; disable or remove project-intake routes without changing backlog semantics.
- 用户确认: User explicitly requested: “继续推进，同意promote 成active task 然后进入spec/plan”.

functional_requirements.text: Provide a project-intake capture route for raw source material.
Store project-intake artifacts separately enough that they are not confused with normal small backlog items.
Support at least text/markdown inputs in the MVP. Binary PPT/PDF ingestion is out of MVP unless already converted to text.
Generate or guide creation of structured analysis sections: requirements, product, UI/UX, technical, risks, and open questions.
Generate or guide creation of a project brief with goals, actors, scope, non-goals, assumptions, dependencies, risks, and acceptance candidates.
Support later creation of PRD/spec and architecture brief evidence from the intake output.
Support conversion from confirmed project-intake output into milestone plan and/or normal backlog items.
Require explicit user confirmation before promotion into implementation or generated backlog items.
Update agent routing so new-project requests do not default to quick or underspecified backlog flows.
Preserve existing backlog commands and behavior for incremental tasks.

non_functional_requirements.text: Deterministic CLI state changes must not depend on network or hidden LLM execution.
Generated artifacts must be auditable through existing DocPath summaries and canonical files.
Existing quick/backlog/spec/plan tests must continue to pass.
The workflow must be resumable through `docpath next --agent`.
Errors must identify missing readiness evidence and next corrective commands.

acceptance_criteria.text: A standard-level project-intake spec and plan exist for `R-242`.
The plan includes discovery, design, implementation, tests, and closeout steps.
The future implementation defines project-intake stages, artifacts, readiness gates, and CLI routes.
Existing backlog and quick workflows remain compatible.
The workflow blocks implementation/decomposition until explicit user confirmation.
Tests cover routing, readiness gates, artifact generation, and backlog compatibility.
